answers.reason: Students do not belong to the group that decides on university-wide statutes, structure, and strategy.
Students are not among the groups that participate in budget planning rounds.
Students do not take part in appointment committees for vacant professorships.
Students do not belong to the faculty council body.

Students are the ones whose examination matters are decided, but the text states groups take part only in their designated body and students are not listed as members of the examination board body itself.
